lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the branchial region. Each visible column in the mid-flank contains between 5 and 7 discrete spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands of similar intensity, forming a grid where high-luminance blobs are positioned at the nodal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin near its distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial and branchial regions display a complex vermiculated pattern of interconnected high-luminance lines and small dots, contrasting with the regular grid pattern of the lateral flank.
